summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares iBonds Dec 2056 Term Treasury ETF (IBGM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the ICE 2056 Maturity US Treasury index. The fund tracks a market-value-weighted index of US Treasury bonds maturing between January and December 2056. The fund will terminate in December 2056. IBGM was launched on Mar 25, 2026 and is issued by BlackRock.

completeness: holdings are the fund's own published portfolio section, dated 2026-10-09; the later index-constituent section of the same file is deliberately not used
this file publishes no provider ticker column, so symbol stays null and the row identifier is the provider CUSIP, ISIN or SEDOL when present
the provider quantity is the file's Par Value column, named literally as its source field; fixed-income rows carry unit par_value and no par value is relabelled as shares
notional value is kept separate from market value
weights are the provider's signed weights, so derivative rows may be negative with no sum-to-100 check
shares outstanding carries the file's own explicit as-of date and no scaling guess is applied
